features: Current-source persistence including invalid JSON and exact numeric literals
Bounded file reads and lossless-encoding guards
Exclusive temp creation, fsync and rename with external-content conflict checks
Cleanup restricted to temporary files created by the current write
History-version dirty tracking and save-while-editing protection
Revision-checked asynchronous load and clipboard replacement
Unsaved save/discard/cancel decisions and nonce-bound protected close
Editor input locked before allowing native close
Raw/formatted/compact current-text clipboard copy and undoable full-document paste
Asynchronous Electron 45 clipboard API with awaited failures
Main menu and consistent native/DOM shortcut routing
Ten persisted application recent files in configurable userData
Exact IPC argument schemas and trusted-main-frame checks
limitations: Native file-dialog choices are supplied by test fixtures; file service, IPC and disk bytes are real
Clipboard native read/write ports are replaced in E2E to avoid changing the user's system clipboard
No OS clipboard or physical dialog manual acceptance is claimed
Hash checks reduce conflicts but do not provide an OS-level atomic compare-and-swap or cross-process lock
No autosave, crash recovery, power-loss durability verification or external-file watching
Recent files are application history rather than OS recent-document integration
Scale regression uses synthetic flat arrays with one paste and three sequential scalar edits per size
notPerformed: Native clipboard and dialog manual acceptance
Physical Chinese IME and mouse drag manual verification
Power-loss, forced termination and long-running memory regression
Installer execution, uninstall, upgrade, signing and publishing
